chat.capabilityDescription: Chat3D can generate gears, enclosures, brackets, adapters, and other mechanical parts from a text description. Pick an example or write your own prompt to get started.

capabilities.gearsExamples: Spur gears · Bevel gears · Module 1–5mm, 10–80 teeth
capabilities.bracketsExamples: L-brackets · U-brackets · Wall mounts · Up to 200mm spans
capabilities.enclosuresExamples: Raspberry Pi cases · Sensor housings · Snap-fit or screw-mount

limitations.title: Known limitations
limitations.organic: Complex organic shapes (e.g. figurines) are not well supported.
limitations.threads: Thread generation may require manual refinement.
limitations.assemblies: Assemblies with multiple moving parts are not yet supported.

examplePrompts.spurGearPrompt: Design a spur gear with 20 teeth, a module of 2mm, and a 5mm center bore.
examplePrompts.piEnclosurePrompt: Create a simple snap-fit enclosure for a Raspberry Pi 4, with ventilation slots and mounting holes.
examplePrompts.lBracketPrompt: Generate an L-shaped mounting bracket, 50mm × 30mm with 3mm thickness and four M4 bolt holes.
examplePrompts.hoseAdapterPrompt: Design a stepped hose adapter that transitions from 12mm inner diameter to 8mm, 40mm long with barbed ridges.
